bundlingNotes: Firm states its flat fee is 'comprehensive for all legal work and costs incurred by the firm for your closing, including title search, title review, document preparation, courier fees, and phone/facsimile fees.' Title insurance premium is billed as 'a separate charge as required by the State of Connecticut' -- i.e. the flat fee is the settlement/attorney fee and explicitly excludes the title insurance premium, the reverse pairing of what WFG/Stewart's premium-only manuals show.
